name: ContentQcIssueLog
tagline: Timecoded QC issues, fix / waive decisions and redeliveries – with a live verdict per asset.
description: A complete content quality-control app for Power Apps and Power Pages: log every picture, sound, subtitle, metadata and compliance finding with timecode and severity, request fixes and redeliveries from the facility, verify fixes on the new version and see which assets pass or fail QC.
features: Timecode validation for 23.976–60 fps with 8-digit quick entry
Severity rules and asset verdicts (Fail / Awaiting verification / Pass with notes / Pass with waivers / Pass)
Fix workflow with allowed transitions and required data per status
Waivers with reason and approver; critical waivers blocked by default
Request / log redelivery per asset with RedeliveryJson
Bulk status, vendor and owner with undo
Log & add next for fast QC logging
Demo mode with fictional sample data
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
